Open bailey, separate octagonal keep, two mapped retaining arcs, Great Hall domed turrets, oriel and porch, low gallery, upper hall, clock stair, chapel and gate passage render. Rear elevations and concealed roofs remain approximations awaiting further architectural reference work.
